Campus Customs — Live App Check

Three checks captured from the running website (frontend on :5174, FastAPI backend on :8000).

Each check below shows a real screenshot taken from the live site during a browser test, with a short note on what it proves. Image files are also saved in outputs/app_check_images/ (embedded here so they always display).

1

Chat inventory matches the database

Handsome Dan reports the Basic Hoodie Big Yale stock as XS 15, S 5, M 4, L 8, XL 2, XXL 25 (59 total) — which matches the inventory table in the database exactly. This proves the agent reports live, accurate stock rather than guessing.

outputs/app_check_images/01_inventory_chat.png
2

Chat search dynamically updates the page

Asking the chatbot "show me quarter zips" updated the storefront to a "Chat results" view of matching quarter-zip product cards. This proves a chat search drives the on-page product grid, and each card links to its own product page.

outputs/app_check_images/02_search_results.png
3

Part 9 usability: add-to-cart & shopping cart

A Branford 1/4 Zip added from the product page appears in the Shopping Cart with size, quantity, remove, and a live order summary (and the navbar cart badge shows "1"). This proves the Part 9 cart and checkout flow works end to end.

outputs/app_check_images/03_cart_usability.png
